prompt: Write curl commands to authenticate with Infisical's REST API using a machine identity and then list all secrets in my project's dev environment.

assertions.text: Uses POST to `/api/v1/auth/universal-auth/login` with clientId and clientSecret in body
Uses the returned accessToken as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
Uses GET `/api/v4/secrets` (not v1, v2, or v3)
Includes projectId and environment query parameters
Does not use service tokens or deprecated auth methods
Includes Content-Type: application/json header on POST requests
